phases.name: Learn
phases.milestone: Ship your first non-trivial PR and complete the system architecture walkthrough.

phases.name: Contribute
phases.milestone: Own a feature end-to-end (design doc, implementation, review, launch) and complete an on-call rotation.

phases.name: Lead
phases.milestone: Drive a technical initiative across at least two teams and mentor a more junior engineer.

goals.title: Complete environment setup, read every relevant ADR, and ship Day 1 hello-world PR
Land 5 small PRs in the first 3 weeks to learn the review culture
Walk the system architecture with the tech lead and document gaps
Own a medium feature end-to-end with a written design doc and review checkpoints
Complete a full on-call rotation and document one new runbook
Establish a weekly engineering 1:1 cadence with at least 3 cross-team peers
Drive a technical initiative that touches at least 2 services or teams
Mentor a more junior engineer through a feature delivery

successDefinition: By Day 90 I'm a trusted contributor — included in design discussions early, comfortable on-call, shipping medium features without a buddy, and starting to be the go-to for at least one part of the codebase.

firstWeekActivities.title: Get dev environment running end-to-end and pass the local test suite
Read the team README and the last 6 months of architecture decision records
Pair with on-call buddy to walk through the alert / incident playbook
Ship a one-line PR with proper code review etiquette to learn the flow
Schedule weekly 1:1s with manager, tech lead, and PM
